FN-OK42JJ-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 279
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Senator Randy Price
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 05/22/2023
Senate Bill 279 as passed the Senate would allow the salaries of elected county superintendents
to be set after their term of office begins. This bill would not otherwise affect state or local
funding.
